notes.title: Demo Ver.0 Patch — Fixed a bug that could prevent progress
notes.content:
KARATE ROGUE Demo Ver.0.250928

Fixed a progression-blocking bug that could occur immediately after New Game on certain environments. We’re sorry for the trouble.

Fixed an issue where the Awakening Skill “Gale Onslaught” increased ACT but still ended the turn.

Optimized several English skill and weapon descriptions.

Adjusted the motion for the ART “Spinning Back Kick.”

Tweaked early-game flow and some lines right after New Game.
